name: AgentRunPreviewCard
description: Pre-save run preview panel for agent settings that synthesizes expected run behavior from in-memory draft configuration and surfaces blockers before persistence.
usage: Render alongside per-agent settings form. Recompute on draft changes using a 250ms debounce. Mark output as Draft until settings are saved.

props.name: validation
props.type: { isValid: boolean; errors: Array<{ field: string; message: string }> }

accessibility.notes: Keyboard: Tab order follows heading -> refresh action -> each preview section -> risk flags. ARIA: role=region with aria-labelledby for the panel heading; use aria-live='polite' for regenerated summary text; associate validation errors with source fields and include non-color text labels for risk severity.

examples: <AgentRunPreviewCard agentId='orion' draftConfig={draft} savedConfig={saved} validation={validation} isDirty onRefreshPreview={refresh} />
<AgentRunPreviewCard agentId='eli' draftConfig={saved} savedConfig={saved} validation={{ isValid: true, errors: [] }} isDirty={false} onRefreshPreview={refresh} />
dos: Show Draft vs Saved status text whenever form state is dirty.
Display explicit blocker copy when preview is unavailable due to validation errors.
Map warning chips to text labels (for example, 'High retry pressure') so status is not color-only.
Keep touch targets at least 44px for refresh and section toggles on 375px layouts.
donts: Do not persist preview output; it must be synthesized from in-memory draft state.
Do not hide validation blockers behind collapsed sections.
Do not mix lime and teal accents on the same control or status chip.
Do not disable keyboard access to preview sections or action buttons.
